title: nlms2~
description: `nlms2~` implements a normalized LMS adaptive FIR filter, producing the filter output `y[n]` and additional outputs for the error `e[n] = d[n] - y[n]` and coefficient vector `c[n]`. Its creation arguments set the number of coefficients and the step-size parameter `mu`; the patch gives the sufficient stability condition `0 < mu < 2`.
